title: Hearty Rich Moroccan Bamboo Shoot Tagine
description: Rich, dense, and romantic Moroccan dish featuring blanched bamboo shoots, perfect for a special evening. This ayurvedic-sattvic-friendly recipe is a delightful variation of traditional tagine cookery.

ingredients.name: Bamboo shoots 250g
ingredients.notes: Blanch before use to remove bitterness

instructions: Heat oil in the tagine pot over medium heat.
Add the onion and cook until softened, 5 minutes.
Add the garlic and ginger and cook for 1 minute more.
Add the cumin, paprika, and cayenne pepper and cook for 1 minute.
Add the blanched bamboo shoots and cook for 2 minutes.
Add salt and black pepper to taste.
Add the preserved lemon and stir to combine.
Transfer the tagine to the oven and cook at 300°F (150°C) for 30 minutes.
Garnish with chopped parsley and serve hot.
Note: this recipe is for refrigerator pickling/preserving only — store in the refrigerator and consume within 1 week. Do not water-bath can without an acid (vinegar or lemon juice).
